scripts.db:start: node -e "console.log('MongoDB is now the primary database. No local PostgreSQL service is started by this script.')"
scripts.db:stop: node -e "console.log('MongoDB is now the primary database. No local PostgreSQL service is stopped by this script.')"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.check: npm run check -w apps/web && npm run check -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api
